real_evidence.source: sanitized SELECT-only observations already collected on 2026-10-08; no production read or write by this certification
real_evidence.substitutions: Synthetic IDs preserve equality relations only. Display hashes are not proof or dedupe keys.

limits: Local PostgreSQL 18.4 only, not hosted DEV/Production certification; migration not remotely applied.
This phase recognizes exact native ID equality in authoritative journal message_id only. No invented provider-certified translation or contact bridge.
Respond currently lacks typed edit/revoke/delivery/read/failure journal events; those cannot match cross-provider in v1.
Existing Meta event_type:native_id key collapses sent-status and app echo for the same ID; correlation never reconstructs discarded evidence or infers human authorship.
Assessment read_at describes the captured MVCC evidence, not completeness of upstream delivery; late evidence appends a new version.
Temporal window +/-2s is candidate triage only; over 200 candidates returns ambiguous/candidate_limit with a 201-row sentinel.
No indexes or consumers added to old journals. Exact matching can scan Respond history; profile query plans before any future scheduled use.
Equivalences are immutable proof artifacts, never business authorization. Inspect latest assessment for later conflicts.
Source FK references retain audited source rows; source retention/deletion requires a separate review.
No SQL rollback deleting evidence. Leave additive tables and revoke evaluator access/stop future callers if needed; this PR has no callers.
